'''Rhand''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located deep within the [[Perann Nebula/Legends|Perann Nebula]],<ref name="TUR" /> in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TUR" /><ref name="EAOC" /> Rhand was once inhabited by a [[Unidentified Rhand species|species]] that disappeared before some members of the [[Knell of Muspilli]], [[Kanzer Exiles]], and [[Warriors of Shadow]] arrived on the planet. These three groups merged after thousands of years to create the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]]. This dark organization expanded their territory in the nearby region known as the [[Nihil Retreat]] but kept Rhand as base of operations. The greatest Sorcerers of Rhand took up residence in the ruins built by a long-dead species and were believed to possess [[Rakatan]] forges and [[Taurannix chapbooks]]. <ref name="TUR" /> Rhand was the homeworld of the Sorcerer of Rhand [[Cronal]], later known as the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] and [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] Blackhole.<ref name="Imperial">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] incorrectly places Rhand in the [[Dreighton Nebula/Legends|Dreighton Nebula]].<ref name="FaDCR" />
